consumes.contract: traces, logs, SLO and failure evidence

live_runtime.rule: Promotion requires each release row to contain live evidence from all six runtime components, a real Week 6 LoRA/QLoRA execution, and Week 7 trace evidence; saved results may materialize inputs but never substitute for execution.

release_rule: A missing upstream artifact or live runtime is a release limitation and must be named in final_report.md.
